question: Which prediction labels survive budget censoring?
identifiable_in_this_finite_model: Budget2 success frequency1/2 and consumed-service mean3/2 coincide. Unlimited mean proof time is not identified by the same records; cap is not an uncensored solve-time label.
logical_WDL: Neither completion label proves which failed contexts are latentWIN; a finite resource UNKNOWN remains semanticUNKNOWN. Lost data is distinct from a recorded completed failure/timeout.
budget_conditioning: Solver-only success, verified success and end-to-end usable selection are different targets. Changing proof/verifier/fallback allocation can change the overall endpoint; no blanket monotonicity of whole-policy quality is inferred from solver time.
decision: An actual future caller may learn an explicitly supervised operational completion/cost target without knowing every WDL. The current source review supplies no actual calibrated priors, timing model, training set or caller implementation; no new campaign/estimator is built.
computation: Exact arithmetic countermodel, not sampled runtime/game/training.
